title: How to Find Job Opportunities
description:
In this class, we’ll cover how to find job opportunities—the tools, tips, and techniques that you would use to find roles that excite you. It's not just about job boards and it's not just about networking; it's really about an approach that encompasses all of it.

We’ll talk about the following in this class:

1. Our approach and our philosophy on how you go to market and how you think about it. 
2. The 3 main ways that you would approach trying to find these incredible opportunities: a people approach, a company approach, and a job approach. You really need to do all three of these to see all the opportunities that are out there. 
3. Tracking your job applications and staying organized, because, as we like to say, what gets measured gets managed. The more organized you can be about your search and all these opportunities that you're out there pursuing, the better that you'll be able to manage it all and bring the job search process to an end.

----------
00:00 | Introduction
01:21 | How to go to market (and how you should think about it)
05:06 | The first approach method - "A people approach"
15:56 | The second approach method - "A company approach."
21:16 | Tracking your job applications and staying organized (with a JOB TRACKER)
27:22 The third approach method - "A job approach."
33:51 | Wrapping Up & Conclusion

For more on how to find job opportunities, open roles, and stay organized in your job search, visit tealhq.com.
